synthetic_terrain_recipe.wind: uniform westward, zero vertical, prescribed input; no GRAMM model run
uniform westward, zero vertical, prescribed input; no GRAMM model run

method: Each functional PR is applied alone to the same upstream source. Fixed seeds, one worker. Each condition excludes one warmup for each variant and uses five interleaved timed repetitions, rotating the order. Whole-process time includes initialization and output. Exact concentration payloads, finite nonnegative values, requested and actual particle counts are checked on every run.
